title: Canonical scalar global-section comparisons
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $S_f(F)=F(X)$ with scalars restricted along $k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Define $d_f:H_k^0(f,F)\simeq S_f(F)$ by the canonical degree-zero right-derived/global-sections comparison [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For $a:Y\to X$, define the top-section pullback by the tensor-pullback adjunction unit followed by restriction from $a^{-1}X$ to $Y$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Define $B:S_f(F)\times S_g(G)\to S_{f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1}(\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ by tensoring these two pulled-back sections [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. It is $k$-bilinear, and its tensor lift is denoted $T$. These definitions choose no unspecified section or equivalence.
